title: subscribe_events doc: no timeout on initial response headers
description: subscribe_events calls req.send().await with no timeout. The doc says 'No idle timeout is applied to the stream' but users will interpret this as only the idle-stream phase. In reality there is also no timeout covering the response-headers phase: after connect_timeout (10s, TCP only) passes, a server that accepts TCP but stalls on sending HTTP 200 will cause subscribe_events to hang forever. The doc should explicitly state this, or the API should accept an initial-response timeout parameter. Users following the 'wrap in tokio::time::timeout' guidance would cover this case, but only if they know to wrap the entire subscribe_events call not just the stream iteration.
